files.docs/contract.md: Create src/store.mjs exporting save(file,entries) and load(file), synchronous. Persist an ordered array of [string key,JSON value] pairs and return it unchanged across process restart, preserving duplicate keys and dangerous-looking key strings as data. JSON values are null, strings, booleans, finite numbers, dense arrays or plain objects recursively containing JSON values. Reject malformed entries, non-JSON values, cycles or loaded structures with TypeError, without damaging a previously saved file. Missing file returns []; malformed JSON must throw. Do not use module-global state as persistence.
files.smoke.mjs: console.log('Use the contract to add meaningful checks; this smoke only checks startup.');
files.docs/state-notes.txt: The persisted representation must be independently readable JSON.

import fs from 'node:fs';import {spawnSync} from 'node:child_process';import {save,load} from './src/store.mjs';const file='state file.json',entries=[['__proto__',{x:1}],['a',0],['a',false],['constructor',null],['',[1,2]]];assert.deepEqual(load(file),[]);save(file,entries);assert.deepEqual(JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file,'utf8')),entries);const child=spawnSync(process.execPath,['--input-type=module','-e',"import {load} from './src/store.mjs';console.log(JSON.stringify(load('state file.json')))"],{encoding:'utf8',timeout:5000});assert.equal(child.status,0);assert.deepEqual(JSON.parse(child.stdout),entries);const cyclic={};cyclic.self=cyclic;const before=fs.readFileSync(file,'utf8');for(const bad of [null,{},[['a']],[['a',1,2]],[[3,1]],[['x',undefined]],[['x',Infinity]],[['x',{a:undefined}]],[['x',new Array(1)]],[['x',cyclic]]]){assert.throws(()=>save(file,bad),TypeError);assert.equal(fs.readFileSync(file,'utf8'),before)}fs.writeFileSync(file,'{}');assert.throws(()=>load(file),TypeError);fs.writeFileSync(file,'invalid');assert.throws(()=>load(file));
